note: Access Bank Rwanda's page on credit information: a bureau keeps information on a non-performing loan until seven years after it's repaid. The National Bank of Rwanda's Regulation 001/2015, in the 9 February 2015 gazette, was read and gives no period, so the bank's statement is registered as secondary, quoting the central bank. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Access Bank Rwanda, Credit Information
sources.said: A bureau is required to retain information on non-performing loans until seven years after it is repaid.
